tasks.title: [FEATURE:medium] Add BOARD_STATE_REQUEST P2P handler for team handoff recovery
tasks.description:
File: packages/node/src/core/engine-adapter.ts

CONTEXT: When a node claims an orphaned team, it needs the team's board state (pending tasks, history). Currently init-platform.ts broadcasts a BOARD_STATE_REQUEST but no handler exists to respond.

WHAT TO BUILD:
1. In engine-adapter.ts or init-kernel.ts, add a P2P request-reply handler for 'pando/board-state-request'.
2. When received, look up the requested teamId's board-state.json from local storage (~/.pando/teams/{teamId}/board-state.json) or from the git repo (.pando-state/{teamId}/board-state.json).
3. If found, respond with the board state JSON. If not found, respond with empty/null.
4. The requesting node (init-platform.ts orphan handler, around line 745) already broadcasts BOARD_STATE_REQUEST and waits 5 seconds. Wire the response back so it can restore board state from a peer.

REFERENCE: Look at existing P2P request-reply handlers in init-kernel.ts (search for 'pando/' handlers like pando/doorman-classify, pando/team-heartbeat). Follow the same pattern.

VERIFY: After fix, if you have board state for pando-infra locally, the handler should respond when queried. Test by checking the handler is registered (look in node logs for the handler registration).
tasks.progress: Already implemented. BOARD_STATE_REQUEST handler at init-platform.ts:996-1015, BOARD_STATE_RESPONSE handler at :1018-1033, getBoardStateSnapshot at engine-adapter.ts:1382, restoreBoardStateFromSnapshot at :1423. MessageTypes in shared/types.ts:182-183. No code changes needed.

tasks.title: [FEATURE:critical] Consolidate chat routing — thread continuation must use sendToTeamAgent not sendToEngine
tasks.description:
File: packages/node/src/api/platform-api.ts

PROBLEM: Three parallel paths exist for routing chat messages to engines. Only Path 1 (build intent, first message) correctly uses the team registry via startTeam() + sendToTeamAgent(). Paths 2 and 3 bypass the team entirely via sendToEngine(). Follow-up messages in project threads skip the team lead agent entirely.

FIX (2 changes in platform-api.ts):

1. THREAD CONTINUATION (line ~588-607): Replace sendToEngine() at line ~592 with sendToTeamAgent(). Pattern: check adapter.isTeamActive(projectId), if not active call startTeam() with lead-universal template, then use adapter.sendToTeamAgent(projectId, 'lead', message). Match the existing build intent path at lines 312-336.

2. PROJECTID SHORTCUT (line ~125-193): Same fix at line ~148. Replace sendToEngine(trimmed, projectId) with the team-based routing pattern.

VERIFY: Send a build chat message, then a follow-up in same thread. Both should appear in /v1/teams/<projectId>/activity. Second message must NOT create a raw engine instance.

tasks.title: [BUG:critical] Board state git commits trigger unnecessary node restarts � restart loop
tasks.description:
File: packages/node/src/init-platform.ts (self-restart watchdog section).

BUG: The self-restart watchdog compares HEAD vs built commit hash. Board state commits (chore: persist board state for {teamId}) change HEAD, triggering a stale-build restart even though no code changed. With 5-min debounced board commits, the node restarts every ~10 min in a loop.

ROOT CAUSE: The stale-build watchdog only checks if HEAD hash differs from built hash. It does not check WHAT files changed.

FIX OPTIONS (pick simplest):
1. Before triggering restart, check if the diff between built and HEAD includes any files in packages/ (compiled code). If only .pando-state/ or docs files changed, skip restart.
2. Or: after detecting stale build, run npm run build and compare output. If build output unchanged, update the built marker without restarting.
3. Or: move board state commits to a separate git ref/branch that does not affect HEAD.

Option 1 is simplest. In the stale-build detection code, add:
  git diff --name-only builtHash..HEAD | grep ^packages/
If no packages/ files changed, update the built hash marker and skip restart.

VERIFY: After fix, board state commits should NOT trigger node restarts. Node should only restart when actual code in packages/ changes.
tasks.progress: Fixed by external ops (commit f7b7a333). Deadlock: internal team could not fix because restart loop prevented 15-min tick from completing. Watchdog now checks git diff for packages/ changes before triggering restart.

tasks.title: [BUG:critical] Fix chat thread POST Thread not found � 1-line fix
tasks.description:
File: packages/node/src/api/platform-api.ts, line ~525.

BUG: POST /v1/chat/threads/:id/message returns 404 Thread not found for ALL newly created threads. This breaks the core chat UX � every new conversation fails on first message.

ROOT CAUSE: Line ~525 uses sync-only cache lookup:
  const existingThread = threadStore.getThread(id);
But createThread() writes to storage async (fire-and-forget), so the sync cache has not been populated yet.

FIX: Change line ~525 to use async fallback (matching the GET handler at line ~448):
  const existingThread = threadStore.getThread(id) || await threadStore.getThreadAsync(id);

The GET handler already does this correctly. The POST handler just needs the same pattern.

VERIFY: After fix, send a new chat message in the hub (http://localhost:3003/chat) � it should respond instead of showing Thread not found.
tasks.progress: Verified: code already has async fallback at line 526. Bug was transient from restart loop period. Confirmed fixed via Playwright test.

tasks.title: Implement board state git commit for team handoff recovery
tasks.description:
RESILIENCE GAP #2: When board state changes (task created/updated/completed), commit board-state.json to the node git repo so handoff to another node preserves task history.

CURRENT STATE: persistBoardState() in engine-adapter.ts already writes board-state.json to ~/.pando/teams/{teamId}/board-state.json after mutations. But this file is LOCAL ONLY � if the node dies and another node claims the team, the board state is lost.

WHAT TO BUILD:
1. Add a commitBoardState(teamId) method in engine-adapter.ts that:
   - Reads the current board-state.json from ~/.pando/teams/{teamId}/
   - Copies it to the node repo at a known path (e.g., .pando-state/{teamId}/board-state.json)
   - Git add + commit with message "chore: persist board state for {teamId}"
   - Use the existing commit-and-propose endpoint (POST /v1/infra/commit-and-propose) OR direct git operations via GitOps class
   - IMPORTANT: Do NOT push on every board change � just commit locally. Push happens via governance on meaningful changes.
2. Call commitBoardState() from persistBoardState() � but debounce it (at most once per 5 minutes) to avoid commit spam.
3. On team handoff (orphan claim in init-platform.ts ~line 740), the claiming node should check if board-state.json exists in the cloned repo at .pando-state/{teamId}/board-state.json and use it as fallback if P2P BOARD_STATE_REQUEST gets no response.

FILES TO MODIFY:
- packages/node/src/core/engine-adapter.ts (add commitBoardState method, call from persistBoardState with debounce)
- packages/node/src/init-platform.ts (add git-based board state recovery fallback in orphan handler ~line 740-760)

CONSTRAINTS:
- Do not break existing persistBoardState() behavior
- Do not break commit-and-propose pipeline
- Debounce commits (max 1 per 5 min per team)
- Use existing GitOps class for git operations
- tsc --noEmit must pass
- Server must boot normally after changes
